description: `review-policy --lane TASK_ID` classifies a lane against a configured `[review_policy.review_risk_paths]` override (cli.py's cmd_review_policy / `risk_areas_touched`, ported as `mv_engine::risk_paths::risk_areas_touched`). This scenario's lane (see `projects.sandbox.lanes` -- conformance/README.md 'Lane fixtures') touches `src/auth/login.rs`, which the configured `auth = ["src/auth/**"]` glob matches, so the one printed line names that area rather than 'low'. Read-only: no Herdr call.
